, Reason for Mistake: The Planner first misidentified the likely 1959 Soviet source as “Nebo i Zemlya (The Sky and the Earth)” instead of Nebo Zovyot (The Heavens Call). This incorrect hypothesis set the search direction off course and later led to the erroneous assertion that the answer was “Battle Beyond the Sun (1959),” conflating the U.S. re-edit with the original Soviet film.
